bounded_host_request.command:

test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2a5775e6d0dddb5e95797a74a3dc29afc761be8f"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker exec debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path"),d="/sandbox-jobs/jobs";for(const x of fs.readdirSync(d)){if(/^JOB_/.test(x)&&fs.existsSync(p.join(d,x,"request.json"))&&!fs.existsSync(p.join(d,x,"result.json")))throw Error("SANDBOX_JOB_PENDING");}console.log("SANDBOX_IDLE=PASS")'
python3 -B /home/admin1/server-core/scripts/servercore_registered_service_deploy.py --repository seigo-gace/debug-ai --target-sha "2a5775e6d0dddb5e95797a74a3dc29afc761be8f" --service sandbox-runner --apply
docker exec debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");fs.readFileSync("/app/server/control/role-prompt-evidence.js");console.log("SOURCE_READABLE=PASS")'
